Mechanical engineering welcomes Lorenzo Mangolini as department chair
The Department of Mechanical Engineering at UC Riverside welcomes Professor Lorenzo Mangolini as its new chair, bringing more than 15 years of experience at UCR and a research program focused on plasma science and engineering. Mangolini joined UCR’s Department of Mechanical Engineering in 2010 after earning his Ph.D. in mechanical engineering from the University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, in 2007 and gaining experience in industry. Collisions Help Explain How Arctic Sea Ice Spreads
Arctic sea ice may look like a continuous frozen surface from a distance. Up close, much of it is a shifting collection of individual slabs called floes, pushed by winds and ocean currents and repeatedly colliding with one another.

June 01, 2026
UCR researchers advance “Living Lung Model” through simulation and experimentation
Researchers at the University of California, Riverside, are advancing what researchers describe as the first continuously ventilated, structurally representative three-dimensional human lung model informed by both organ- and tissue-level experimental data. Led by Professor Mona Eskandari and trainees in UCR’s bioMechanics Experimental and Computational Health (bMECH) Laboratory, the research was highlighted at the 2025 SIMULIA Americas Users Conference, where postdoctoral researcher Dr. Arif Badrou presented new findings from the international Living Lung Project.
